items.headline: City in closed talks over Finch Avenue property
items.summary: The October 6 City Council closed session agenda listed real property negotiations involving 10480 Finch Avenue in Cupertino, with the city manager and interim city attorney named as negotiators.

items.headline: Chabad seeks permit for Sunnyvale worship space
items.summary: A use permit application before the Zoning Administrator would allow Chabad of Sunnyvale to operate a religious assembly space inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, which sits in an R-1 residential zone.

items.headline: Human Relations panel to weigh in on housing bond measure
items.summary: The Human Relations Commission's September 29 agenda included considering whether to recommend that the City Council take a formal position on California Proposition 1, the Veterans and Affordable Housing Bond Act of 2026.
